text_block_list.text: One day, while strolling along the riverbank――

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ugh, geez!! Nothing's biting at all!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, calm down. It's precisely that impatient mindset
that causes the fish to get away.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Once you take up the rod, keep your mind serene.
Conceal all trace of desire, and wait patiently for the moment――

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Here it is!
(FLAP-FLAP-FLAP!!)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...And that's about the gist of it.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Gnuuugh...! Reeling one in so easily again!
You're hiding a secret trick, aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: So let me catch one too, will you~?! Ugh, there's no way I'm giving up~...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehhh...?
Even if you say that... Aaargh...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey. You over there. Could you
give this person some advice?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Nothing's worked since this morning.
I just want them to catch at least one fish, though.
choice_data_list: What if you changed how you move the fishing rod?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, true. Maybe I'll try somewhere else.
Vibes differ from person to person, after all.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Which means at the next spot, catches worthy of a first-class lady will be splashing in droves...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright, calm down.
You're gonna scare the fish away again, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Still, asking others for help ain't a bad deal after all.
Thanks a bunch for the advice!

—Later on, rumors circulated that Seiun Sky
and King Halo had reeled in
an unbelievable monster catch.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oho~? Picking up the pace from the midpoint,
just like in an actual race—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: A race!? Are you saying you intend to spill your race strategy to King herself!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Change of plans!
Now, I shall grant you the privilege of telling
King every last detail of your strategy right this instant!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, well...? Was that how the story went?
Either way, the knack for racing and the knack for fishing might actually be surprisingly connected.
